zh: 一只高阶恶魔一直在偷酒。你决定找到并打败她，看看能否问出艾娃的消息。

source: You're very lucky! You recognized one of the women who appeared in your mother's XXX magazines! She says she'll give you a special service for old times' sake.
zh: 真走运！你认出了妈妈那些色情杂志上出现过的一位女郎！她说，看在老交情的份上，会给你特别服务。

source: You found a woman with violet pigtails at the corner of the bar. She says she can lend you money, but you must pay her back with an additional ten percent.
zh: 你在酒吧角落遇到了一位梳着紫色双马尾的女人。她愿意借钱给你，但归还时，要额外收取百分之十的利息。

source: There's a cat woman playing very mean pranks on the villagers, and they're blaming Callie's daughter. Find the real culprit and save Callie's daughter!
zh: 有个猫娘正在对村民恶作剧，闹得很过分，大家却怪到了卡莉女儿头上。找到真正的罪魁祸首，救救卡莉的女儿！

source: The plant woman from the shop told you she's very thirsty, and Lili suggested buying her beer to see if she'll give you discounts while drunk.
zh: 商店里的植物女说她渴坏了，莉莉提议买啤酒给她，看看灌醉之后能不能讨点折扣。

source: A dragon woman fell from the sky among the prisoners and seems to be fighting to prevent a crystal from being stolen. Lili suggests we help her; maybe they'll reward us with something valuable.
zh: 一个龙女从天而降，落在囚犯中间，似乎在拼命保护一块水晶，不让它被抢走。莉莉提议帮她，也许能得到值钱的谢礼。

source: There's a strange woman with pink hair hiding in a corner of the circus. Find out why people are talking about her.
zh: 马戏团角落藏着一个奇怪的粉发女人。弄清大家为什么都在谈论她。

source: You found your favorite heroine! Sam, the protector of Tricotex. Prove that you have what it takes to embark on a capture mission with her.
zh: 你找到了最喜欢的女英雄——特里科特克斯的守护者萨姆。向她证明，你有实力和她一起执行抓捕任务。

source: Someone is impersonating a knight of Elira to scam people. Catch them and be the heroine you always wanted to be!
zh: 有人冒充艾莉拉的骑士行骗。抓住骗子，成为你一直向往的女英雄！

source: Kristoff, a VIP customer at the bar, is very angry and asks if you can buy him some premium cigarettes to help him calm down.
zh: 酒吧的贵宾克里斯托夫正在发火，问你能不能买些高档香烟，帮他消消气。

source: The hotel secretary informs you that you've caught the attention of a woman who will be waiting for you on the top floor of the hotel. Hmm, what could she want? It might be important.
zh: 酒店前台告诉你，一位女士注意到了你，会在酒店顶层等你。嗯，她想干什么？说不定很重要。

source: You've become a minion of a seemingly powerful individual! They order you to bring the dimensional fracture, which looks like a floating crystal, to leave this dimension.
zh: 你成了一位看起来很强大的家伙的跟班！对方命令你带回那个形似漂浮水晶的次元裂隙，好离开这个次元。

source: There was a collapse in the cave, leaving many miners trapped. Wait until the knight of Elira clears the passage.
zh: 洞窟发生坍塌，许多矿工被困在里面。等艾莉拉骑士清开通道吧。

source: There are some rumors of strange sounds coming from the Silent Forest at night. What could it be?
zh: 传闻寂静森林一到夜晚就会传出怪声。会是什么呢？

source: An Onahole is desperate to buy a boat and is selling her body to do so. As an act of charity, help her.
zh: 一个肉便器为了买船，正拼命卖身赚钱。发发善心，帮帮她吧。

source: Ivy, a honey slime, recognizes you as an adventurer who helps people and asks if you can help her find a part of herself that hasn't returned.
zh: 蜂蜜史莱姆艾薇认出你是个乐于助人的冒险者，想请你帮忙，找到她一直没有归来的那部分身体。

source: You heard the Grand Captain of the Elira Guards arguing with a woman about the ineptitude of the knights. Maybe if you help them, they can assist you in your quest.
zh: 你听见艾莉拉卫队的大队长，正和一名女子争论骑士们有多无能。也许帮帮他们，他们也能在你的寻找之旅中助你一臂之力。

source: You encountered Faye, a space-dimensional traveler trapped in your dimension. You decided to help her because you felt sorry for her.
zh: 你遇到了被困在此处的跨次元旅行者菲伊。觉得她可怜，便决定伸出援手。

source: Vasuki tells you that something bad is happening at the mushroom house in the magenta swamp. Upon investigating, it seems that there may be human trafficking and drug activities occurring there.
zh: 瓦苏基告诉你，洋红沼泽的蘑菇屋里出了坏事。调查之后，那里似乎涉及人口贩卖和毒品交易。

source: You found someone smelling the flowers, but as soon as you spoke to them, they attacked you. Find out what's really going on!
zh: 你发现有人在闻花香，可一开口，对方就攻击了你。弄清究竟发生了什么！

source: There's something about Marael that doesn't quite convince you. Look into what she's really hiding.
zh: 玛拉艾尔总有些地方让你不太放心。查清楚她到底藏着什么。

source: A letter addressed to Marael gives you clues that a woman named Willow also contacted Ava. Look for her to gather more information.
zh: 一封写给玛拉艾尔的信透露，有个叫薇洛的女人也联系过艾娃。去找她，多打听些消息。

source: There's a bard woman looking for an adventurer to inspire her. Show her that you're a worthy adventurer capable of inspiring others!
zh: 一位女吟游诗人正在寻找能激发她灵感的冒险者。向她证明，你就是值得歌颂、能鼓舞他人的那个人！

source: After being attacked by a pervert who opened his leather coat and showed you everything, something awakened inside of you.
zh: 一个变态向你敞开皮大衣，把里面露了个精光。遭遇这次袭击后，你心里的某样东西觉醒了。

source: The island is cordoned off because someone stole the relics from the church. As part of the deal to stay on the island, you agree to help the knights of Elira search for the relics.
zh: 有人偷走了教堂圣物，整座岛因此被封锁。作为获准留在岛上的交换条件，你答应帮艾莉拉骑士寻找失窃的圣物。

source: An Onahole stuck to the wall in the VIP area of the bar tells you that if you buy her entire outfit, she'll give you a rimjob!
zh: 酒吧VIP区有个被固定在墙上的人形飞机杯。她说，只要买齐她全身那套衣服，就给你舔肛！

source: Lili says you're very stinky and need a bath.
zh: 莉莉说你臭死了，得赶紧洗澡。

source: The librarian is lost, and no one knows where she is. Look for her, and perhaps you'll find more information about the people who go missing on the island.
zh: 图书管理员失踪了，谁也不知道她去了哪里。找到她，也许能进一步查清岛上的失踪事件。

source: Gildfried, a businessman on vacation on the island, unfortunately lost his briefcase, which is very important to him.
zh: 来岛上度假的商人吉尔德弗里德，不幸弄丢了对他非常重要的公文包。

source: Lemmy, a green monster outside an automated carriage, talks to Lili and asks for help because his mistress is having trouble.
zh: 自动马车外，一只名叫雷米的绿皮怪物找上了莉莉。它的女主人遇到了麻烦，想请你们帮忙。

source: Sakura is working at the renowned fast food restaurant Smooshers! She asks for your help in searching for the lost uniforms.
zh: 樱正在著名的快餐店斯慕舍打工！她请你帮忙找回丢失的制服。

source: One of Vasera's clones has gained autonomy. Vasera will go search for it and neutralize it. She advises you to kill it if you encounter it.
zh: 瓦瑟拉的一个克隆体有了自主意识。瓦瑟拉会去寻找并处理掉它，还提醒你，一旦遇到就杀了它。

source: Sieki got angry with you because even though she already paid the debt to MsHonney, you're still in the VIP area. Now you follow her orders to avoid making her angrier.
zh: 茜姬已经替你还清了欠蜜糖女士的债，你却还赖在贵宾区，惹她生气了。现在，你只能乖乖照她的话做，免得她火上浇油。

source: The farmer confesses that she would like to work with less clothing. How could you help her work more comfortably?
zh: 农场女工坦言，想穿得少一点干活。怎样才能让她干活时更舒服呢？

source: The fortune teller confessed to you that she would like to have a red crystal orb because with it she could see her own future.
zh: 占卜师向你坦白，她想要一个红色水晶球，因为那样就能看见自己的未来。

source: The water nymph who works at the bar is looking for love but is insecure because she doesn't know if people approach her for the beer or if they genuinely want something with her.
zh: 酒吧里的水仙女渴望爱情，却又缺乏安全感：她不知道别人接近她，究竟是为了啤酒，还是对她真有意思。

source: Accidentally, you ruin Naoki's concoction just as he's entering mating season, so you decide to help him.
zh: 你不小心毁了直树的药剂，偏偏他正要进入发情期，于是决定帮帮他。

source: Lucy the bard is having trouble with an Onahole, so you decide to help her with whatever she needs.
zh: 吟游诗人露西遇到了一个人形飞机杯引发的麻烦，你决定帮她解决。

source: There are portals for self-satisfaction in the VIP area of the bar, but a witch won't let you use them.
zh: 酒吧贵宾区设有能让人自我满足的传送门，可一个女巫不让你使用。

source: Sieki has a big problem and makes you a deal you can't refuse: you just have to attend to the clients in the VIP area while she's away, and you'll become a VIP customer.
zh: 茜姬遇到了大麻烦，提出一个让你无法拒绝的交易：她不在的时候，你只需招待VIP区的客人，就能成为VIP。

source: A hospital robot offers anal cleaning services for just three thousand Arcs. It's not a bad idea to keep clean every now and then.
zh: 医院机器人提供肛门清洁服务，只需三千阿克。偶尔清理一下，也挺不错。

source: A story you read in the library seems strange to you, so you decide to look for more information about it.
zh: 图书馆里读到的一则故事让你觉得很奇怪，于是决定寻找更多线索。

source: There's a guy offering his services to make fursuits, which catches your attention, so you decide to save up for one.
zh: 有人提供兽装订制服务，你很感兴趣，决定攒钱买一套。

source: There's an Onahole that has the same tone as you, which strangely excites you.
zh: 有个飞机杯的肤色和你一模一样，这居然让你莫名兴奋。

source: In a nightclub, you find two gothic girls with big butts dancing, something you can't let pass in your life.
zh: 你在夜店遇到了两个扭着大屁股跳舞的哥特女孩，这种机会，一辈子都不能错过。

source: Upon entering the usually closed public restroom, you find an idol vomiting, with many people screaming and demanding the show. What could be happening?
zh: 走进平时关着的公共厕所，你发现一个偶像正在呕吐，外面还有许多人尖叫着要求开演。到底怎么回事？

source: There is a proliferation of slimes attacking and kidnapping women. Do your best to help and get to the bottom of this!
zh: 大量史莱姆四处袭击、绑架女性。尽力帮助她们，查清事情的真相！

source: A being living in the pond enters Line's mind and psychologically strips her bare with questions she's not prepared to hear or face.
zh: 池塘里的某个存在进入莱茵的内心，问出她毫无准备、不愿听到也不愿面对的问题，将她的心理防线层层剥开。

source: You don't know what's happening; you have mental gaps, and days and nights seem to pass in seconds.
zh: 你不知道自己怎么了，记忆出现空白，白天黑夜仿佛几秒钟就过去了。

source: You have committed serious mistakes that haunt you at night, so you decide to confess to expiate your sins.
zh: 你犯下的严重错误让你夜不能寐，于是决定去忏悔，赎清罪孽。

source: Callie invites you to meet her family, which seems more serious than what you're looking for, but it would be rude not to go.
zh: 卡莉邀请你认识她的家人，关系好像比你想要的更认真了，可不去又太失礼。

source: You found a place that can serve you for sleeping while you investigate the island.
zh: 你找到了一个调查岛屿期间，可以歇脚过夜的地方。

source: You need more power, so you beg Marael to help you unlock your succubus powers.
zh: 你需要更强大的力量，于是恳求玛拉艾尔帮你解放魅魔之力。

source: The thieves on the island aren't just any criminals; they were actually stealing to maintain an orphanage, without which everything would collapse.
zh: 岛上的小偷并非普通罪犯。他们偷东西，是为了维持孤儿院的运转；没有他们，这里的一切都会垮掉。

source: You met Futaba your trusted futanari in the forest, what could she be doing?
zh: 你在森林里遇到了信得过的扶她伙伴双叶，她在那里做什么呢？

source: The barn is very busy due to the issues happening on the island. Help them however you can so that the barn can open.
zh: 岛上的种种事件让谷仓忙得不可开交。尽可能帮忙，让谷仓能重新开门吧。

source: Rynn is frustrated because the last fight with you didn't end, so she challenges you to a beer drinking duel.
zh: 琳恩对上次和你没打完的架耿耿于怀，要和你比喝啤酒，一决胜负。

source: Lili is angry with Line because she believes Line is completely ignorant about sex, and challenges her to a competition to see who is the better onahole.
zh: 莉莉觉得莱茵对性一窍不通，为此大为光火，还向她下了战书：比比谁才是更棒的肉便器。

source: The milk on this island has very strange properties.
zh: 这座岛上的牛奶，有着非常奇怪的功效。

source: A fat ugly bastard bothering Rynn at the bar he leaves but you can't stop thinking about him.
zh: 酒吧里，有个丑陋的胖混蛋纠缠着琳恩。他虽然走了，你却怎么也忘不掉他。

zh: 跟卡莉睡过后，你觉得自己脏兮兮的，去她的浴室洗个澡吧。

zh: 卡莉似乎想找你说话，去见见她吧。

source: Callie invited you to have lunch, go to her house during the day.

zh: 现在该怎么办？我要让她想着我，我要让她恨我，我要让她想着我，我要让她恨我，我要让我的身影再也离不开她的脑海！

zh: 调查医院里出现有意识的史莱姆的原因！

source: Defeat the pink slime that is trying to enter the hospital.
zh: 击败想闯进医院的粉色史莱姆。

source: According to the information from the guards, there is a slime near the hospital.
zh: 根据卫兵提供的消息，医院附近有一只史莱姆。

source: Hola este es el contexto de la quest como te va a mi me va muy bien <3 tiene que ser largo igual mas o menos dos lineas xd :v
zh: 你好呀，这是任务说明，最近怎么样？我过得很好<3。得写长一点，差不多两行吧，哈哈:v。

source: Do you need help? Don't worry, I will explain what you need to know to win all your fights.
zh: 需要帮忙吗？别担心，我会教你怎样赢下战斗。

source: First, the basics: align three or more cubes to make them explode and deal damage.
zh: 先讲基础：把三个或更多相同方块连成一线，就能消除它们，造成伤害。

source: If you align four cubes at the same time, the hit will be stronger and a cube will evolve.
zh: 同时连起四个方块，攻击会更强，还会让一个方块进化。

source: If you align five or more cubes, a maximum cube will be created, and I will come out to fight!
zh: 连成五个或更多方块，就会生成一个极限方块，我就能出来战斗了！

source: Oh, and I almost forgot! When the cubes explode, all adjacent cubes of the same type will also explode and add up to deal more damage.
zh: 哦，差点忘了！方块爆炸时，相邻的同类方块也会一起爆炸，累积造成更多伤害。

source: Don't worry, I'll explain the graphic to you. First of all, there are cubes with specific requirements, like the magic cube (hat) and the nature cube (leaf).
zh: 别担心，我会给你解释这张图。首先，有些方块需要满足特定条件才能使用，比如魔法方块（帽子）和自然方块（叶子）。

source: If you align them, they will explode like any other cube, but the difference is that if you don't have mana, they won't have any effect.
zh: 连起来时，它们也会像普通方块一样消除。不过，如果魔力不足，就不会产生效果。

source: Now, this restriction might seem bad, but it has a reason: these cubes are more powerful.
zh: 这个限制看起来可能不太好，但事出有因：这些方块威力更强。

source: For example, the magic cube deals double damage and the nature cube allows you to recover health.
zh: 比如，魔法方块造成双倍伤害，自然方块则能帮你恢复生命。

source: The chart in the middle indicates which type of damage has an advantage over another.
zh: 中间的图表表示不同伤害类型之间的克制关系。

source: Both Line and the monsters have their own elements, which can be either weak or strong.
zh: 莱茵和怪物都有各自的属性，彼此之间可能克制，也可能被克制。

source: To see a monster's damage affinity, you can check it in the Waifsteary.
zh: 想了解魔物对各种伤害的抗性，可以查看魔物娘图鉴。

source: Line will have the affinity of the strongest element they possess, whether it's slash, pierce, impact, or magic.
zh: 莱茵的属性取决于目前最强的元素，可以是斩击、穿刺、冲击或魔法。

source: These special cubes are really simple, so let's explain them.
zh: 这些特殊方块其实很简单，现在就来说明吧。

source: The potion cube will restore mana. The broken heart cube reduces the enemy's damage, attack interval, and healing.
zh: 药水方块可以恢复法力。碎心方块会降低敌人的伤害、攻击间隔和治疗效果。

source: Why is this girl taking so long?
zh: 这姑娘怎么去了这么久？

source: Oh, cutie I can upgrade a block of hearts every so often on the grid in addition to doing some cut damage.
zh: 小可爱，我每隔一段时间，都能把棋盘上的一个爱心方块强化，另外还能造成少量斩击伤害。

source: No but, could you tell me again how you fight?

source: No right now actually.

source: Yes Big sis <3!

source: You want a little break cutie
zh: 想稍微休息一下吗，小可爱？

source: No thanks, could you tell me again how you fight?
zh: 不用了，谢谢。能再讲讲你是怎么战斗的吗？

source: Sorry big sis not rigt now.
zh: 对不起，大姐姐，现在不行。

source: Yes, Big Sis.
zh: 好的，姐姐。

source: Do you want me to help you in battles?
zh: 要我帮你战斗吗？

source: So do your best Line <3.
zh: 所以，莱茵，加油哦<3。

source: A training battle will do.
zh: 来场训练战就行。

source: First of all I need to see your current status as a succubus in a more precise way.
zh: 首先，得更准确地了解你目前作为魅魔的实力。

source: So how do we start?
zh: 那我们怎么开始？

source: Well said! <3
zh: 说得好！<3

source: I know .. I guess it will hurt my mother if I never get better as a succubus.
zh: 我知道……如果作为魅魔一直没进步，妈妈大概会很难过。

source: But line, beautiful, it is your culture we gain power and energy having sex, you must start thinking about yourself.
zh: 可是莱茵，小美人，这就是你的种族习性啊。我们靠性爱获得力量和能量，你也该为自己着想了。

source: And my father is a very respectable elf. What would he think of me, I don't want to hurt him?
zh: 而且爸爸是一位德高望重的精灵。他会怎么看我？我不想伤他的心啊。

source: But I was always such a shy girl, that I never asked my mother to teach me.
zh: 可我一直特别害羞，从来没开口请妈妈教我。

source: I ... I want to be a better succubus
zh: 我……我想成为更好的魅魔。

source: hey quiet fairy, I just want to teach your friend some tricks so that she is a little more prepared for the world.
zh: 喂，妖精，安静点。我只是想教你的朋友几招，让她出去闯荡时，多一点准备。

source: Hey! What's wrong? Line is a great succubus!
zh: 喂！怎么了？莱茵明明是个很棒的魅魔！

source: You are a succubus but I see that you have a long way to go, your power is minimal compared to others.
zh: 你是个魅魔，不过还有很长的路要走。跟其他魅魔比，你的力量微不足道。

source: Help me with what?
zh: 帮我什么？

source: I made this little meeting to help you.
zh: 我安排这次小聚，就是想帮你。

source: Why did you want to see me?
zh: 你为什么想见我？

source: Mmm?( this woman does not give me confidence )
zh: 嗯？（这个女人，感觉不太可靠。）

source: If only you knew what I was my little fairy.
zh: 我的小仙女，你要是知道我以前是什么样就好了。

source: How do you know who Line is and what she is?
zh: 你怎么知道莱茵是谁，还知道她的身份？

source: Oh.. thanks hehe.
zh: 哦……谢谢，嘿嘿。

source: Yes, and you are a cute little half succubus you right Line.
zh: 没错，你是个可爱的小半魅魔，对吧，莱茵。

source: Lili
zh: 莉莉

source: E-excuse me, did you leave a message to the receptionist for me?
zh: 打、打扰一下，是你在前台给我留了话吗？

source: Come on Line try again I need to know better your current state I know you can do more.
zh: 来，莱茵，再试一次。我得更了解你现在的状态，我知道你不止这点本事。

source: Just give me one second.
zh: 稍等我一下。

source: Mmmm... Hehe ok big Sis I will do my best <3
zh: 嗯……嘿嘿，好呀，大姐姐，我会努力的<3

source: Great Line you already know something about the case more than I do find them and I'll give you a prize Tehehehe.
zh: 太好了，莱茵，看来你知道的案情已经比我还多。找到它们，我就给你奖励，嘻嘻嘻。

source: I already know that story.
zh: 那个故事我已经听过了。

source: A Slime Cat is apparently stealing it.
zh: 好像有只史莱姆猫在偷它。

source: Well, if you want me to help Line become a better succubus, first help me recover the clothes from the restaurant.
zh: 好吧，既然想让我教莱茵成为更好的魅魔，就先帮我把餐厅里的衣服拿回来。

source: The truth is that I do know but I hope you don't do it simply because it's moral 101.
zh: 其实我知道，不过就算只是出于最基本的道德，也希望你别这么做。

source: It's for the greater good plus I eat well here if you know what I mean.
zh: 这是为了大家好嘛。而且我在这里也吃得不错，懂我的意思吧。

source: Oh, don't get mad, I'm working so I don't always sleep in that pigsty you call a house.
zh: 哎，别生气嘛。我在打工，这样就不用总睡在你管它叫家的那个猪窝里。

source: I mean, weren't you supposed to help Line become a better succubus or something?
zh: 你不是该帮莱茵成为更厉害的魅魔之类的吗？

source: Big Sis, what are you doing here?
zh: 大姐姐，你怎么来了？

source: Did you find the Outfits?
zh: 找到那些制服了吗？

source: I will give you a prize, just come behind the counter.
zh: 给你个奖励，来柜台后面吧。

source: Oh... it is ok.
zh: 哦……没关系。

source: That cat is a thief and we need them for the waitresses as we are full.
zh: 那只猫是个小偷，我们店里都忙满了，女服务员还等着制服穿呢。

source: Oops, you look great but I'll need them back.
zh: 哎呀，穿着真好看，不过这些衣服得还给我。

source: Mmmm yeah, I took it from a slime cat, I think it looks pretty good on me.
zh: 嗯，是啊。从一只史莱姆猫那里拿的，我觉得还挺适合我。

source: Wow Line those Smoosher outfits?
zh: 哇，莱茵，那是斯慕舍餐厅的制服？

source: All right, come behind the counter.
zh: 行，来柜台后面。

source: Big Sis found them! Wh-which ones my prize hehe?
zh: 大姐姐找到了！那、那我的奖励呢，嘿嘿？

source: I do the basics, cut damage and every so often I upgrade a cut cube.
zh: 我会些基础招数，造成斩击伤害，偶尔还能升级一个斩击方块。

source: No.
zh: 不。

source: Yes.
zh: 好。

source: You are tired alredy?
zh: 这就累了？

source: Sorry, I cant right now u.u.
zh: 抱歉，现在不行u.u。

source: mmm ok.
zh: 嗯，好吧。

source: Hey I am bored Wanna do something?
zh: 喂，我好无聊，要不要一起做点什么？

source: Is that you Line? c'mon in
zh: 是莱茵吗？进来吧。

source: Moo
zh: 哞

source: I recommend you to improve your life so you don't die with one of my attacks.
zh: 建议你先提升生命值，免得挨我一下就死。

source: My way of fighting is normal, I do a lot of magic damage but big of the damage I do to the enemy you get it too, sadly I'm not good at team fighting.
zh: 我的战斗方式挺普通，魔法伤害很高，可我对敌人造成的伤害，有很大一部分你也得挨。可惜，我不太擅长团队作战。

source: No thanks.
zh: 不用了，谢谢。

source: Yes I need to do something by my own sorry :c
zh: 是，我得自己去办点事，对不起:c

source: You look tired, do you want to rest?
zh: 你看着很累，要休息吗？

source: I recommend you to improve your life and nature so that I am the one doing the damage while you concentrate on surviving my attacks and those of the enemies.
zh: 建议你提升生命值和自然属性。这样我来负责输出，你就专心扛住我和敌人的攻击。

source: My way of fighting is normal, I do a lot of magic damage but half of the damage I do to the enemy you get it too, I'm not good at team fighting.
zh: 我的战斗方式很普通，能造成大量魔法伤害，但我对敌人造成的伤害，你也会承受一半。我不擅长团队作战。

source: Not really hehe but thanks.
zh: 也不是啦，嘿嘿，不过谢谢。

source: Can you help me in my adventure <3?.
zh: 能帮我一起冒险吗<3？

source: Thanks for the help, you need something?
zh: 谢谢帮忙，有什么需要的吗？

source: That depends on them and their resistance.
zh: 那要看他们自己，还有他们的抵抗能力。

source: .... Mhmm Sir? please don't kill anyone.
zh: ……嗯，先生？请别杀人。

source: Ohh you are so kind and thoughtful <3 hehe.
zh: 哦，你真温柔，又体贴<3嘿嘿。

source: I told your fairy that I would get money.
zh: 我跟你的妖精说过，会去搞点钱。

source: Mr. Vasera, what are you doing here?
zh: 瓦瑟拉先生，你怎么在这里？

source: If you want to go with me to look for him, I won't stop you, but I won't defend you either, you should take care of yourselves.
zh: 想跟我去找它，我不会拦着，但也不会保护你们。你们得照顾好自己。

source: How thoughtful. <3
zh: 真贴心<3。

source: The truth is I am already looking for it, I just told them to be careful.
zh: 其实我已经在找了，只是提醒她们小心一点。

source: Hey wait we could help you look for it so you can absorb it again and get your full strength.
zh: 哎，等等，我们可以帮你找啊！找到后再吸收回去，不就能恢复全部力量了吗？

source: Oh this is not good.
zh: 哦，这可不妙。

The truth is that it is too late, I will have to fine you with 100 arcs for lack of respect for authority.

zh: 来呀，臭婊子

source: Get the hell out of my territory you thot
zh: 滚出老娘的地盘，贱货。

source: It may already be time to get back to work, I miss announcing the news.
zh: 也该回去工作了，真想念播报新闻的日子。

source: I wouldn't miss it for anything in the world.
zh: 说什么我都不会错过。

source: Mmm.. hi there will be a mini show at the circus I would appreciate it if you could go.
zh: 嗯……你好，马戏团要办个小演出，能来捧场就太好了。

source: *blushed* th-thank you it is a relief that you liked it.
zh: *脸红*谢、谢谢，你能喜欢，我就放心了。

source: That was a great show.
zh: 真是场精彩的演出。

source: Sorry (but I didn't do anything :c).
zh: 对不起。（可我明明什么都没干:c。）

source: She is very sorry, say sorry *covers Line's mouth*
zh: 她非常抱歉，快道歉。*捂住莱茵的嘴*

source: Oh, well if you wan..
zh: 哦，要是你想……

source: Excuse me? that no way of speaking if I were your mother I would punish you.
zh: 什么？怎么能这样说话！我要是你妈妈，非罚你不可。

source: Shit! Line look at that ass.
zh: 操！莱茵，快看那个屁股。

source: Finally I finished cleaning this floor, Mr.Cabello will be happy <3.
zh: 这层楼终于打扫完了，卡贝洛先生会高兴的<3。

source: Thanks Line for the help <3.
zh: 莱茵，谢谢你帮忙<3。

source: MMm where to go next, what place will inspire me? to write my next hit.
zh: 嗯，接下来去哪儿呢？什么地方能激发灵感，让我再写出一本畅销书？

source: But, what?...well whatever. I hope you can accomplish your mission miss but if it gets too dangerous run away please I don't want my book to be tainted by someone dying or getting lost in the woods.
zh: 可是，什么？……算了。希望你能完成任务，小姐。不过太危险就请逃跑，我可不想自己的书，沾上害人死掉或迷失森林的事。

source: I will do my best I will be worthy of the sword *reverence*.
zh: 我会尽力，不辜负这把剑。*行礼*

source: What are you talking about? I never said you were going to look for her, and I don't really care either, no one has taken her out so far.
zh: 你在说什么？我从没让你去找她。说实话，我也不在乎，反正迄今还没人把它拔出来过。

source: Thank you very much I will not let you down and I will bring the sword.
zh: 太感谢了！我不会让你失望，一定会把剑带来。

source: Well one enters the forest and must follow these directions up, down, left, left, left, right, down and finally up. But beware that even if I am not here, the spiritual energy of one of my ancestors may try to deny you passage..
zh: 进入森林后，按这个方向走：上、下、左、左、左、右、下，最后再向上。不过小心，即使我不在，我某位先祖的灵力也可能阻挡你。

source: And how I got there!
zh: 那我又是怎么进去的！

source: Yes, but there came a time when I really understood that she didn't need me to take care of her, she was quite lost in the forest and to get her out you have to have the requirements I wrote down, even so I don't understand how that helps to get the sword out.
zh: 是，不过后来我终于明白，她根本不需要我照顾。她迷失在森林深处，想把她取出来，就必须满足我写下的条件。即便如此，我还是不懂，这些跟拔剑有什么关系。

source: What the heck?!
zh: 搞什么鬼？！

source: Oh relax you will be surprised to know that it is true my family was the one who took care of the sword although we never managed to get it off the anvil.
zh: 哦，别紧张。说来你可能不信，那是真的，我们家族一直守护着那把剑，只是始终没能把它从铁砧上拔出来。

source: Uh sorry sir my friend fell out of the crib when she was a baby we won't bother you anymore eh hehe ehh..
zh: 呃，抱歉，先生，我朋友小时候从婴儿床里摔过。我们不打扰了，嘿嘿，呃……

source: YES! You know that when I read your story I did not feel that the sword is true and I can feel it on the island.
zh: 没错！读你的故事时，我还不觉得那把剑真的存在，可现在，我能感觉到它就在岛上。

source: Mmmm yes I am surprised to find fans here, was it because of the back cover?
zh: 嗯，在这里碰见粉丝，真是意外。是看了封底才来的吗？

source: Hello sir, are you by any chance the author of The Pelletclad Blade?
zh: 你好，先生，请问你是《弹丸之刃》的作者吗？

source: You say that because of the sheets in his hand...I guess it's worth a try.
zh: 就因为他手里拿着那些纸，你就这么说……？算了，试试也无妨。

source: Looks like a writer?
zh: 他看着像作家吗？

source: Ehh it must be because of the years it was stored out in the open hehe.
zh: 呃，应该是因为在露天放了太多年吧，嘿嘿。

source: What, you managed to get the sword I'm glad it has a new owner but why does it smell so strange?
zh: 什么，你找到剑了？真高兴它有了新主人，不过为什么闻着这么奇怪？

source: Hey do you want something really chingon?.
zh: 嘿，想要点真正牛逼的东西吗？

source: Oh give me a second I'm getting my suit ready.
zh: 哦，等一下，我在准备兽装。

source: Mmmhe MMMhe I understand I will have it ready when I bring the 5000 arcs leave it all to me.
zh: 嗯哼，嗯哼，我明白了。带来5000阿克币时，我就会准备好，放心交给我。

source: Mmmm ok but I want this for my furrsuit *whispering* shp shp shp shapa shapa shapa.
zh: 嗯……行，不过我的兽装要这样……*低声耳语*嘘嘘嘘，沙巴沙巴沙巴。

source: I know it's expensive but understand that the suit is custom made with all the specifications you want.
zh: 我知道很贵，可这套衣服是量身订做的，你想要什么细节都能做。

source: Great it's only 5000 Arcs
zh: 太好了，只要5000阿克币。

source: You've already convinced me how much it costs!
zh: 你已经把我说服了，多少钱！

source: I'm not going to lie to you, it's expensive, but if it's any incentive Miss Marael says that sex in a furrisuit is quite an experience.
zh: 不瞒你说，是挺贵的。不过说点能让你心动的：玛拉艾尔女士说，穿兽装做爱可是别有一番滋味。

source: Now I want to be a furry!
zh: 我现在也想当兽人控了！

source: Yes haha she was part of the furry community before deciding to live life as a goat woman.
zh: 是啊，哈哈。在决定作为羊女生活之前，她也是兽圈的一员。

source: Really?!
zh: 真的？！

source: Oh you talk about Miss Marael what a nice woman she was my first time.
zh: 哦，你说的是玛拉艾尔女士啊。多好的女人，我的第一次就是给她的。

source: Mmm... I am half succubus and I cannot even transform myself to the taste of others, I met a succubus who decided to live life as a black goat woman, I would really like to change my form and know how it would be like to be a real succubus.
zh: 嗯……我明明有一半魅魔血统，却连按别人的喜好变身都做不到。我认识一个魅魔，选择用黑山羊娘的样子生活。我也很想改变形态，体验一下真正的魅魔是什么感觉。

source: Not all of us are lucky enough to be born as one or transform ourselves but with these costumes we have the opportunity to live life from a different perspective.
zh: 并不是每个人，都有幸天生如此，或能变身。但有了这些兽装，我们也能从另一个角度体验生活。

source: Well, it all depends on whether you admire atropomorphic animals like wolves.
zh: 嗯，得看你喜不喜欢狼这一类拟人动物。

source: Mmm I do not know what's in it for me?
zh: 嗯，不知道，我有什么好处？

source: I don't know Line looks like a weirdo.
zh: 不知道，莱茵，他看着像个怪人。

source: Would you like to be part of our community?
zh: 你愿意加入我们的圈子吗？

source: OH how cute I love your fluffy little ears <3.
zh: 哦，好可爱！你毛茸茸的小耳朵，我太喜欢了<3。

source: Indeed, I am an honorable member of the furry community.
zh: 没错，我是兽圈的光荣一员。

source: ... H-hi e- that's a costume?
zh: ……你、你好，呃，那是套扮装服？

source: Ohmm HI I am Snugglepaws!
zh: 唔，你好，我叫绒绒爪！

source: No I am still short of money :c.
zh: 没有，我的钱还不够:c。

source: Did you get the money?
zh: 钱凑齐了吗？

source: Thank you very much Mr. Snugglepaws.
zh: 非常感谢，绒绒爪先生。

source: Let's go home Lili, I need your help!
zh: 莉莉，回家吧，我需要你帮忙！

source: Ohhhh I love it I love it I love it I love it that's all I wanted <3!
zh: 哦——好喜欢，好喜欢，好喜欢，好喜欢！就是我想要的<3！

source: Here it is, your furrsuit of rabbit woman with movable mouth, automatic blinking, with soft light blue magenta hair!
zh: 给，你的兔女兽装！嘴能动，还会自动眨眼，毛发是柔软的浅蓝色和品红色！

source: Oh it's okay I'll wait here <3.
zh: 哦，没关系，我在这里等<3。

source: Yes, everything is here. (pay 5000 Arcs)
zh: 是，都在这里。（支付5000阿克币。）

source: Not yet.
zh: 还没有。

source: Thank you very much but I am no longer Line now call me Bluebell.
zh: 非常感谢，不过我已经不叫莱茵了，现在请叫我蓝铃。

source: Go Line I know what you want to do.
zh: 去吧，莱茵，我知道你想做什么。

source: ... good, thank you.
zh: ……好，谢谢。

source: Oh Bluebell did you like the suit?
zh: 哦，蓝铃，喜欢这套兽装吗？

source: Oh hehe we really have a very similar voice, masturbating thinking about my own voice will be something very strange hehe although something exciting.
zh: 哦，嘿嘿，我们的声音真的很像。想着自己的声音自慰，还挺奇怪的，嘿嘿，不过也有点刺激。

source: Wow you sound a lot like me, haha ,well I have a fura fura fruit if you want to eat one.
zh: 哇，你说话跟我真像，哈哈。我有颗芙拉芙拉果，想吃一颗吗？

source: No, no, no, no, I-I want to hehe sorry for overthinking it.
zh: 不不不，我、我愿意。嘿嘿，对不起，想太多了。

source: If you don't want to, it's okay, lady.
zh: 你要是不愿意，也没关系，女士。

source: Oh Mmmm (exactly, pretend to think so they don't find out you're desperate).
zh: 哦，嗯……（没错，装作在考虑，别让人看出自己已经急不可耐。）

source: Hello Miss, by any chance do you want to use my hole?
zh: 你好，小姐，要不要用用我的洞？

source: Only the family may enter this sanctuary.
zh: 只有家族成员能进入这座圣所。

source: Come on Run! I bet 1000 Arcs on you Hu HU HU HU HUghg!.
zh: 快跑啊！我可在你身上押了1000阿克，呼哈哈哈哈！

source: I'll do it sir, don't worry. Line now you've gone too far give it some space.
zh: 先生，我来吧，别担心。莱茵，这次你过分了，给她留点余地。

source: Please someone get this girl out of my vital space.
zh: 谁来把这姑娘从我的私人空间里弄出去，拜托。

source: OH! *approaches at too uncomfortable a distance* thank you thank you thank you very much sir I will use your wisdom with care.
zh: 哦！*凑近到让人非常不适的距离*谢谢，谢谢，太感谢了，先生！我会谨慎运用你的智慧。

source: Eheee... I guess every time I'm going to do something that involves force I pound my chest for some reason it makes me feel stronger.
zh: 呃……每次要做使力气的事，我好像都会捶胸，也不知道为什么，就是会觉得更有劲。

source: Can you tell me how to get the strength of a gorilla please please pleaseeeeee?
zh: 能教我怎么获得大猩猩的力量吗？拜托拜托，求求你啦？

source: ... The last time I checked, I was indeed.
zh: ……至少上次确认的时候，确实是。

source: Ho hello are you a gorilla?
zh: 你、你好，你是大猩猩吗？

source: No no no we are just travelers looking for our friend ;c.
zh: 不不不，我们只是来找朋友的旅人;c。

source: Oh I *hip* see, you are allies of the empire trying to erase part of history.
zh: 哦，我*嗝*懂了，你们是帝国的同伙，想抹掉那段历史。

source: hey miss hero we're a little busy it was good your story and all, but we have to keep moving.
zh: 喂，女英雄小姐，我们正忙着呢。你的故事挺精彩，不过我们得走了。

source: doesn't matter! you should know this world is forgetting *hip*roes and I'll make them remember.
zh: 不重要！这世界正在遗忘英*嗝*雄，我会让他们想起来。

source: Mmm ... n-no, i didn't know i'm half elf half succubus actually.
zh: 嗯……不、不是，其实我是半精灵、半魅魔。

source: Thats nice really nice you *hip* know my father protect all the humanity and they dont even know *hip*t.
zh: 真好，真好啊。你*嗝*知道吗，我父亲保护着全人类，可他们根本不知道*嗝*。

source: Eh, I'm not the bartender but if you want I'll call her.
zh: 呃，我不是调酒师，不过可以帮你叫她。

source: Hey, yo skinny girl do something good and bring me some beer *hip*.
zh: 喂，那个瘦姑娘，做点好事，给我拿杯啤酒来。*嗝*

source: You know what, I'm not going to go kill the demon that steals the beer shipments. it's my freaking vacation!
zh: 知道吗？偷啤酒货物的恶魔，我才不去杀。这可是老子的假期！

source: AHHGG! I came to relax on the only island that has no alcohol.
zh: 啊——！我来放松一下，结果偏偏挑了唯一没酒的岛。

source: Line ... let's get out of here.
zh: 莱茵……我们走吧。

source: Oh don't worry i have being in this place before. i will repair it and problem solve.
zh: 哦，别担心，以前来过这里。我修好它，问题就解决了。

source: I-it's not funny, you broke the table with the fight
zh: 这、这不好笑，你们打架把桌子弄坏了。

source: And I think with this fight the effect of the beer were off Hahaha.
zh: 打完这场架，我感觉酒都醒了，哈哈哈。

source: You fight very well, I don't think you're with the weaklings of the empire.
zh: 你很能打嘛，看来不是帝国那群窝囊废一伙的。

source: I will repair it after a few drinks haha.
zh: 喝上几杯，我就去修，哈哈。

source: it doesn't matter break his ass Line!
zh: 不管了！莱茵，揍烂他的屁股！

source: Woomy!
zh: 呜咪！

source: So you are the prankster!
zh: 原来你就是那个捣蛋鬼！

source: Ngyes!
zh: 嗯耶！

source: I need you to come with me because of you an innocent woman will go to jail!
zh: 你得跟我走！因为你，一个无辜的女人就要坐牢了！

source: Woomy Woomy!
zh: 呜咪，呜咪！

source: I guess as long as she doesn't make any more trouble it's okay for her to stay here.
zh: 只要她不再惹事，留在这里，应该也没关系。

source: I guess when he fled he found this cave.
zh: 我猜，他逃跑的时候发现了这个洞窟。

source: Why is it here anyway?
zh: 话说，它为什么会在这里？

source: Oh... could happen to anyone.
zh: 哦……谁都有可能遇上。

source: I also remember when you beat him, he attacked you and you fainted and pissed yourself, what a day.
zh: 我也记得那次你赢了他，然后他反击，你直接晕倒，还尿了裤子。真是难忘的一天。

source: Look Lili is the cat that almost put Callie in jail, well, she end up in jail anyways but you know.
zh: 看啊，莉莉，就是那只差点害卡莉坐牢的猫。好吧，卡莉后来还是坐牢了，不过你懂我的意思。

source: RAWR!
zh: 嗷！

source: I hope Whipsie is doing well on Tricotex.
zh: 希望薇普茜在特里科特克斯过得好。

source: This farm reminds me of home.
zh: 这个农场，让我想起了家。

source: Take it for granted me and Line can against everything!
zh: 放心吧，我和莱茵联手，什么都能摆平！

source: I guess a little help wouldn't hurt, but I'll have to see if they are both up to the task to be my partner.
zh: 有人搭把手也好，不过得先看看，你们两个够不够格做我的搭档。

source: Sorry sam for her lack of delicacy, she a big fan of you.. and so am I, but I mean who doesn't hehe.
zh: 萨姆，抱歉，她说话太冒失了，她是你的超级粉丝……我也是。不过，谁又不是呢，嘿嘿。

source: Wow really can we help to capture it ?!
zh: 哇，真的？我们能帮忙抓它吗？！

source: For now she is the one who takes care of the city, I come to this island because a Tricotex criminal came here.
zh: 现在由她守护城市。我来这座岛，是因为有个特里科特克斯的罪犯逃到这里了。

source: Yeah and where is your partner Whipsy :c?
zh: 是啊，你的搭档薇普西呢:c？

source: Oh well, actually we are not from here, but we knew your stories of how you saved the streets of Tricotex while we travel.
zh: 哦，其实我们不是本地人，不过旅行时，听说过你拯救特里科特克斯街区的故事。

source: Wow, I didn't think anyone would recognize me around here.
zh: 哇，没想到在这里会被认出来。

source: H-hi you are Sa-Sam the hero o-of the Tricotex right :O?
zh: 你、你好，你是萨、萨姆，特、特里科特克斯的英雄，对吧:O？

source: You come for the rematch?
zh: 来复仇了？

source: Haha it's very simple, I do a lot of impact damage.
zh: 哈哈，很简单，我能造成大量冲击伤害。

source: I still want to accompany you.
zh: 我还是想陪着你。

source: sorry same I have other things to do.
zh: 对不起，萨姆，我还有别的事。

source: If you don't have time to catch the criminal, we can part ways for a while.
zh: 你要是没空追捕罪犯，我们可以暂时分开一阵。

source: No sorry, could you tell me again how you fight?
zh: 不了，抱歉。能再讲讲你是怎么战斗的吗？

source: Sorry same I have other things to do.
zh: 对不起，萨姆，我还有别的事。

source: Let's catch that criminal <3.
zh: 去抓那个罪犯吧<3。

source: Now you have time to help me catch the criminal?
zh: 现在有空帮我抓罪犯了吗？

source: Come back as you were!
zh: 变回原样！

source: I do a lot of magic damage that's all you need to know.
zh: 我会造成大量魔法伤害，你知道这些就够了。

source: I am sorry I have to go to the bathroom :c.
zh: 抱歉，我得去趟厕所:c。

source: Sorry but, could you tell me again how you fight?
zh: 抱歉，不过能再讲讲你是怎么战斗的吗？

source: I really want to help you Faye.
zh: 我真的想帮你，菲伊。

source: Hey, if you don't have time to help me just say it, it will be faster for me to look for myself.
zh: 喂，没时间帮忙就直说，我自己找还快一点。

source: Oh ok.. lets go.
zh: 哦，好……走吧。

source: I don't want to waste your time. :c
zh: 我不想耽误你的时间:c。

source: If you want to help me just don't waste my time.
zh: 想帮忙，就别浪费我的时间。

source: I will rest a little here.
zh: 我在这里歇一会儿。

source: I think it's southeast from here.
zh: 我想，应该在这儿的东南方。

source: Where is she now?
zh: 她现在在哪儿？

source: Yes, I think a cow that escaped from the farm ran into the idiot that did this to me.
zh: 是啊，好像有头从农场跑出来的牛，撞上了把我弄成这样的那个白痴。

source: Do you know where he went or if anyone saw him?
zh: 知道他去哪儿了，或者有没有人见过他？

source: Thanks, I came to buy some milk and something covered me in this stuff.
zh: 谢谢，我来买牛奶，结果被什么东西弄得满身都是。

source: Calm down, I will help you.
zh: 冷静，我会帮你的。

source: Shit somebody help me get this out
zh: 妈的，谁来帮我把这东西弄掉。

source: Yeah, she went to the cultivation of nana leaves
zh: 嗯，她去种娜娜叶的地方了。

source: Thanks, I came from buying some special milk and something covered me with this thing.
zh: 谢谢，我刚买完特制牛奶回来，就被什么东西弄得满身都是这玩意儿。

source: Shit somebody help me get this out.
zh: 妈的，谁来帮我把这东西弄掉。

source: Oh ok, if that is what you want but let me tell you that I fight a little different than the rest.
zh: 哦，好，既然你这么想，不过先说好，我的战斗方式和别人有点不一样。

source: You beat him ?! Please fight me in a sparring match.
zh: 你打败他了？！拜托，跟我切磋一下。

source: I know you will, with enough practice you will beat him like I did <3.
zh: 你会做到的。只要勤加练习，你也能像我一样打败他<3。

source: I would like to be stronger to face it again.

source: Mom there is a cat doing pranks to people.
zh: 妈妈，有只猫在捉弄别人。

source: leave my mommy alone.
zh: 别欺负我妈妈。

source: I'm not going to that place with that sucking milk machine 2000.
zh: 有那台吸奶机2000在，我才不去那个地方。

source: Come on miss, accompany me to jail-farm.
zh: 来吧，小姐，跟我去监狱农场。

source: Calm love, I'll be back in a few days.
zh: 别担心，亲爱的，我过几天就回来。

source: But mommy ;c
zh: 可是妈妈 ;c

source: I don't care, it's was worthed.
zh: 我不在乎，值了。

source: I will take you to the jail-farm for assault on social security entities.
zh: 袭击维护社会治安的执法人员，我得把你带去监狱农场。

source: And you fucking inoperative social parasite you should learn how to do your fucking job before you put people in jail.
zh: 你这他妈的废物、社会蛀虫！先学会怎么做好自己的破工作，再来把人关进牢里！

source: Of course they are innocent, children cover your ears.
zh: 她们当然无辜。孩子们，捂上耳朵。

source: Really? It seems her daughters were innocent after all.
zh: 真的？看来她的女儿们确实是无辜的。

source: Wait there were new attacks on other people it couldn't be his daughters they were here with you.
zh: 等等，又有其他人遇袭，不可能是她的女儿们，刚才她们一直和你在这里。

source: I'm sorry miss will you have to come with me or you will have increased the time in jail-farm.
zh: 抱歉，小姐，你得跟我走，不然在监狱农场待的时间，还得加长。

source: Of course not, you closet slut.
zh: 当然不是，你这闷骚婊子。

source: But, I don't really care much about those powers.
zh: 可是，我对那些能力其实没多大兴趣。

source: Yes, but the good side is that you can buy clothes and absorb them into your sacred clothes, these will change in combat which will improve your half-succubus abilities <3.
zh: 是啊。不过好处是，你可以买新衣服，让圣衣将其吸收。战斗中圣衣会变换形态，增强你半魅魔的能力<3。

source: What?! b-but these clothes are sacred, my father will be very angry :c.
zh: 什么？！可、可这些衣服是神圣的，爸爸会很生气的:c。

source: Before going to chase the angel, your mother imbue succubus magic in the elven clothes your father gave you.
zh: 去追那个天使前，你妈妈给你父亲送的精灵衣服，注入了魅魔魔法。

source: Oh no, Lili and now what have you done.
zh: 不好，莉莉，你这次又干了什么？

source: Emmm. yes .. but there is something I didn't tell you.
zh: 呃，嗯……不过，有件事我没告诉你。

source: But for what, the magic clothes that my father gave me are enough to fight.
zh: 可为什么？爸爸给我的魔法衣服，已经够用来战斗了。

source: Line look a store maybe you can buy new equipment.
zh: 莱茵，看，有家店，说不定能买点新装备。

source: Select the 'natural' option.
zh: 选择“天然”选项。

source: Then you go to equipment and in the section where you have the boots on.
zh: 接着打开装备栏，找到装备靴子的那一格。

source: You have to go to the menu press enter.
zh: 得先打开菜单，按回车键。

source: Line to take off your boots.
zh: 莱茵，把靴子脱掉。

source: Oh ok but that is within the normal :s but if it is required, I can could trie more things.
zh: 哦，好吧，不过这也算正常范围内的事:s。要是有必要，我也可以试试更多东西。

source: Yeah shure, she seemed somewhat annoyed if we help her, she will most likely give us a price cut,are you with me Line?
zh: 当然啦。她看起来有点烦躁，帮她一把，说不定就能打折。莱茵，跟我一起吗？

source: No! You're wrong, I just want to be a little stronger, nothing more.
zh: 不是！你想错了，我只是想稍微变强一点，没别的。

source: Oh so now you want new stuff, don't pretend to be a saint you wanted to excite your opponents with new clothes.
zh: 哦，现在又想买新东西了？别装清纯了，你就是想穿新衣服勾得对手兴奋。

source: What are we going to do Lili :s.
zh: 莉莉，我们要怎么办:s？

source: What the hell! those prices.
zh: 什么鬼！这价格！

source: AHHH FORGET WHAT YOU SAW!
zh: 啊啊啊，忘掉你看到的！

source: Oh, I almost forgot, give these pamphlets to the people.
zh: 哦，差点忘了，把这些传单发给大家。

source: I might know where he could be.
zh: 我也许知道他在哪儿。

source: Of course, if she came to this island for the same reason that all tourists come.
zh: 当然，她来这里，跟其他游客都是同一个目的。

source: If I help you, could you help us by getting information from my friend?
zh: 如果帮你，你能帮我们打听朋友的消息吗？

source: People have to know that the red tent will open soon so im kinda busy.
zh: 得让大家知道红色帐篷快开张了，所以我现在有点忙。

source: I'm sorry, sweetie but now I can't, I'm going to do stand up to attract some people.
zh: 抱歉，宝贝，现在不行。我要去说单口喜剧，招揽点观众。

source: Hi, can you give me a little of your time? I'm looking for a friend.
zh: 你好，能耽误你一点时间吗？我在找一个朋友。

source: Give those pamphlets to people while I get ready.
zh: 我准备的时候，你去把这些传单发给大家。

source: You should have told me that you like these types of shows. we could one of us here <3.
zh: 早说你喜欢这种表演嘛，我们自己也能在这里来一场<3。

source: You can see the place while we prepare all.
zh: 我们准备的时候，你可以先四处看看。

source: oh You don't have to thank me, oh I almost forgot the circus is still in preparation but there a girl with pink hair near the stands that you might like.
zh: 哦，不用谢。对了，差点忘了，马戏团还在准备，不过看台附近有个粉头发女孩，你也许会感兴趣。

source: I'm good , and thank for the information and the other thing hehe.
zh: 我很好，也谢谢你的消息，还有另外那件事，嘿嘿。

source: *whisper* oh god the jokes of this bitch.
zh: *低声*天哪，这贱人的笑话真是够了。

source: Hi Line, how have you bee-n.
zh: 嗨，莱茵，最近过得怎——么样。

source: Hi MsHonney.
zh: 你好，霍妮女士。

source: welcome to the green hills hotel at the moment we do not have rooms available
zh: 欢迎来到青丘旅馆，目前没有空房。

source: Welcome to the green hills hotel at the moment we do not have rooms available.
zh: 欢迎来到绿丘旅馆，目前客房已满。

source: Go to the door on the left she will be waiting for you.
zh: 去左边那扇门，她在那里等你。

source: Wow I never thought that a young girl who looks so innocent would go to see her.
zh: 哇，真没想到，这么个看着纯情的小姑娘，会去找她。

source: Oh-sorry i havent sleep lately.
zh: 哦，对不起，最近一直没睡好。

source: Geez Line control yourself.
zh: 老天，莱茵，克制一下。

source: What?
zh: 什么？

source: I love you.
zh: 我爱你。

source: Mshonney have new workers.
zh: 蜜糖女士招了新员工。

source: Welcome to the green hills hotel.
zh: 欢迎来到绿丘酒店。

source: ok ok just give me a sec
zh: 好，好，等我一下。

source: I will sell it and be free again.
zh: 我会把它卖掉，重新获得自由。

source: I escaped from jail but I had no place to go or money, this place is my only option, I must win the golden key.
zh: 我越狱了，可既没地方去，也没钱，这里是唯一的选择。必须赢到黄金钥匙。

source: I-I can't here callie, you know I'm shy, there are a lot of people here
zh: 我、我不能在这里，卡莉，你知道我害羞，这里人太多了。

source: But your love, you can take it right here.
zh: 不过，你的爱意，可以就在这里给我。

source: My children are the best <3 tell him that here it is not so bad, they even pay me to produce milk.
zh: 我的孩子们最棒了<3。告诉他，这里也没那么糟，他们甚至付钱让我产奶呢。

source: Oh ok, your kids send you good vibes since they can't come.
zh: 哦，好吧，你的孩子们虽然来不了，也托我祝你一切顺利。

source: Sorry here just let us say moo.
zh: 抱歉，这里只许我们说“哞”。

source: Whaaat?.
zh: 什——么？

source: Mooo.
zh: 哞。

source: Hey Line come here.
zh: 嘿，莱茵，过来。

source: Yes, she wants me to stay close to her since I am 18 years old and she doesn't want me to go to places that were previously restricted to me on the island.
zh: 对，她想让我一直待在她身边。我刚满18岁，她不想让我去岛上那些以前不准我去的地方。

source: Wait are you the saleswoman's son?
zh: 等等，你是那个售货员的儿子？

source: Bye I have to go
zh: 再见，我得走了。

source: No, but I know that north from here they did the same to a fox girl.
zh: 没有，不过听说北边有个狐女，也被这样整了。

source: Wait do you know who did this to you?
zh: 等等，你知道是谁把你弄成这样的吗？

source: Thanks I have to go.
zh: 谢谢，我得走了。

source: Oh do not worry I will take that thing from you.
zh: 哦，别担心，我帮你把那东西拿掉。

source: yeah she went to the cultivation of nana leaves.
zh: 对，她去种娜娜叶的地方了。

source: Thank you lady unicorn but be careful that cat likes to prank people :c.
zh: 谢谢你，独角兽女士，不过要小心，那只猫喜欢捉弄人:c。

source: Oh I just got to the town but if I see it I'll let you know <3.
zh: 哦，我刚到镇上，不过看见的话，会告诉你的<3。

source: Mmm no, and have you seen a blue cat by chance?
zh: 嗯，没有。话说，你见过一只蓝猫吗？

source: Hello by chance have you seen someone with wings on their head?
zh: 你好，有没有见过一个头上长着翅膀的人？

source: yeah just give use the money
zh: 对，把钱给我们就行。

source: That is, if they do not return with the money on time you will have to work in the village dairy farm to pay it
zh: 就是说，如果没按时带钱回来，你就得在村里的奶牛场工作还债。

source: We take the money
zh: 我们拿走钱。

source: sounds really easy actually
zh: 听着还真挺简单。

source: It's easy, I'll lend you money and you return it to me later with an extra 10%
zh: 很简单，我借你钱，你之后还我，再多付10%。

source: Oh ok what do we have to do?
zh: 哦，好，我们要做什么？

source: I don't know Line having money is always good
zh: 不知道，莱茵，有钱总是好的。

source: Me mmm .. not really
zh: 我？嗯……还真没有。

source: Hey you look like you need money.
zh: 喂，你看起来很缺钱。

source: Great just sign here.
zh: 很好，在这里签字。

source: Amazing, it's great to do deals with you.
zh: 太棒了，跟你做生意真愉快。

source: I gave you 1000 arcs plus 10%, you should give me back 1100.
zh: 我借你1000阿克币，加10%的利息，你该还我1100。

source: No, sorry you will have the money later.
zh: 抱歉，还不行，钱以后再给你。

source: Yes, here is your money.
zh: 有，钱在这里。

source: You are going to give my money back?
zh: 你是来还钱的？

source: Sure just sign here
zh: 当然，在这里签字就行。

source: He-hello could you lend me money again?
zh: 你、你好，能再借我点钱吗？

source: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

source: Ask for money.
zh: 借钱。

source: You need money again?
zh: 又缺钱了？

source: Ok I even liked hehe.
zh: 好啊，我还挺喜欢的，嘿嘿。

source: ...sorry for getting you into this moo..
zh: ……对不起，把你卷进这件事，哞……

source: Moo...
Do not believe her little girl, she is joking.
zh: 小姑娘，别信她，她在开玩笑。

source: Lili!
zh: 莉莉！

source: That's true, especially someone like Line she is a freak.
zh: 那倒是真的，尤其莱茵这种怪胎。

source: My mom told me not to talk to strangers.
zh: 妈妈说，不能跟陌生人说话。

source: Please help miss traveler.
zh: 旅人小姐，请帮帮忙。

source: And you fucking inoperative social parasite you should learn how to do your fucking job before you put people in jail-farm.
zh: 还有你，这个他妈的废物社会寄生虫，把人关进监狱农场之前，先学学怎么做好你的破工作吧！

source: Could you say hello to my mommy if you go near the jail-farm the children can't go out beyond the town.
zh: 经过监牢农场时，能替我向妈妈问好吗？小孩子不能离开镇子。

source: Thanks for helping my family.
zh: 谢谢你帮助我的家人。

source: Those are weird clothes for an elf, come on in
zh: 对精灵来说，这身衣服倒挺奇怪，进来吧。

source: Not now, I'm watching that none of these cows attempt a breakout.
zh: 现在不行，我得看着这些牛，免得有哪个又想越狱。

source: It seems you like to see our cows.
zh: 看来，你很喜欢看我们的奶牛。

source: Rawr
zh: 嗷

source: Rawr.
zh: 嗷。

source: Oh-ok.
zh: 哦，好吧。

source: Be careful stepping on the mushrooms.
zh: 小心别踩到蘑菇。

source: It seems that everything is back to normal hehe I'm going to make some money with these drunkards
zh: 看来一切都恢复正常了，嘿嘿，我去赚这些酒鬼的钱了。

source: That... is... The most logical thing I've ever heard in my life thank you very much for the information <3!
zh: 这……是……我这辈子听过最有道理的话！非常感谢你的说明<3！

source: *whispering* What a stupid thing to do.
zh: *小声*真是蠢透了。

source: MMmm if you want to be pure like a rabbit bring your hands to your head and move them like a bunny <3 oh and don't forget to say pyon pyon.
zh: 嗯，想像兔子一样纯洁，就把手举到头顶，学兔耳朵那样动一动<3。哦，别忘了喊“蹦蹦”哦。

source: If you have anything you can help me with please let me know!
zh: 有什么我能帮忙的，尽管告诉我！

source: Mmm looking for the purity of a rabbit and how to replicate it?
zh: 嗯，在研究兔子的纯洁，以及如何复制这种纯洁？

source: Hey I hope my advice is helping you <3
zh: 喂，希望我的建议帮到你了<3

source: Do me the favor of saying no if she talks to you about those things, she is my best friend but I wouldn't like her to come between us.
zh: 帮个忙，她再跟你提这种事，就拒绝她。她是我最好的朋友，但我不想让她插进我们之间。

source: Oh I almost forgot Ms honney, she sometimes looks for people who want somewhat different experiences.
zh: 哦，差点忘了霍妮女士，她有时会找想体验不同玩法的人。

source: She will be there don't worry Callie.
zh: 她会在那里的，卡莉，别担心。

source: So I could introduce you to my children in a more appropriate way than now haha.
zh: 这样，我就能比现在更正式些，介绍孩子们给你认识了，哈哈。

source: Haha I would also like you to come to my house for lunch.
zh: 哈哈，我也想请你来家里吃午饭。

source: I love that you liked it.
zh: 你喜欢，我很开心。

source: Well, hehe that was  awesome.
zh: 好吧，嘿嘿，刚才真棒。

source: Come, join us for lunch.
zh: 来，陪我们一起吃午饭。

source: You will love it, it is cheap, tasty and fast <3 .
zh: 你会喜欢的，便宜、好吃，还快<3。

source: Oh sure, I've never eaten that kind of food before but it looks delicious.
zh: 哦，当然。我以前没吃过这种食物，不过看起来很好吃。

source: Line! You arrived, did you see the feast I have prepared?
zh: 莱茵！你来了！看到我准备的这桌大餐了吗？

source: Oh give me a second Honey, I'm doing the dishes.
zh: 哦，亲爱的，等我一下，我在洗碗。

source: Thank you, to get to the library just follow this road to the west of town.
zh: 谢谢，去图书馆的话，沿着这条路，一直往镇子西边走就行。

source: Mmmm I will see if I can find out anything, do not worry, you can go back to reading your favorite books.
zh: 嗯，我去看看能不能打听到什么。放心，你可以继续读你最喜欢的书了。

source: I don't know, the librarian is missing so the library is closed.
zh: 不知道，图书管理员失踪了，所以图书馆关门了。

source: Oh, why what happened?
zh: 哦，怎么了，出了什么事？

source: Aw man, I wanted to go to the library.
zh: 唉，本来还想去图书馆呢。

source: You find anything yet?
zh: 找到什么了吗？

source:
Mmmmm, oHhh, Ah ha wooooow.
I forgot I can't read.
zh:
嗯，哦，啊哈，哇——。
忘了，我不识字。

source: I will have to show you what I want to save you from
zh: 我得让你看看，我究竟想救你远离什么。

source: if you're going to trust that demon
zh: 你真要相信那个恶魔的话。

source: I'm really sorry ava, I believe lili
zh: 真的对不起，艾娃，我相信莉莉。

source: please line you have to believe me, I am part of you, if I say that something horrible will happen to you, it will happen to me anyway, stop it before it's too late
zh: 求你了，莱茵，一定要信我。我就是你的一部分。如果我说你会遭遇可怕的事，那我也逃不过。快停下，别等来不及了。

source: calm Line let me continue with this and everything will be solved
zh: 冷静，莱茵，让我继续，一切都会解决的。

source: but why ava, what have i done to you i thought we were best friends
zh: 可是为什么啊，艾娃，我做错了什么？我以为我们是最好的朋友。

source: you do not talk to me like that, you are a mistake of nature you caused all this and I will try to fix it
zh: 不许这么跟我说话。你是自然的错误，这一切都是你造成的，我会想办法修复。

source: don't believe this crazy bitch she she tries to murder you and your mother
zh: 别信这个疯婊子，她、她想杀了你和你妈妈！

source: don't worry Line everything will be fine you don't need to do anything
zh: 放心，莱茵，一切都会好的，你什么都不用做。

source: What's wrong with you, why do you escape from me?
zh: 你怎么了，为什么要躲着我？

source: Line, I do this for you please understand me
zh: 莱茵，我都是为了你，请理解我。

source: Ava please stop
zh: 艾娃，请住手

source: I'm sorry but I haven't seen her around here.
zh: 抱歉，我没在这附近见过她。

source: Oh okay, I wanted to ask, you have seen a woman with wings in her head around here?
zh: 哦，好吧。想问一下，你有没有在附近见过一个头上长着翅膀的女人？

source: Unfortunately we ran out of alcohol a little while ago.
zh: 很遗憾，酒刚刚卖完了。

source: Welcome to the bar fluid sky.
zh: 欢迎来到流液天空酒吧。

source: This broom has been here for a long time, I don't think they will come looking for it, it will help you travel faster through the town <3.
zh: 这把扫帚在这里放很久了，应该没人会来找。给你用，能让你在镇上移动得更快<3。

source: Well the truth haha I have nothing here but I had thought to give you something from the lost & found box.
zh: 其实，哈哈，我手头什么都没有，不过可以从失物招领箱里拿点东西给你。

source: Thank you very much beating that demon was quite an odyssey but gestures like these make it worth it <3.
zh: 太感谢了，打败那个恶魔真是一波三折。不过看到这种心意，就觉得一切都值得了<3。

source: *covers Line's mouth and murmurs* shut-up.
zh: *捂住莱茵的嘴，小声说*闭嘴。

source: Thanks.
zh: 谢谢。

source: Thanks but i beat the Demond for reasons of my own.
zh: 谢谢，不过我是为了自己的事，才去打败那个恶魔的。

source: Thanks but it's not necessary.
zh: 谢谢，不过不用了。

source: Let me give you something for all the trouble.
zh: 给你点东西，补偿你受的麻烦。

source: Hey wait you are the adventurer who defeated the demon that stole alcohol?
zh: 嘿，等等，你就是打败那个偷酒恶魔的冒险者？

source: Go to the door on your left Sieki is waiting for you.
zh: 去左边那扇门，茜姬在等你。

source: Then the rain washes it away.
zh: 随后，雨水将它冲走。

source: Stones it brings.
zh: 它带来石头。

source: When the river sounds.
zh: 无风不起浪。

source: Leave uncomfortably without saying goodbye.
zh: 尴尬地离开，不说再见。

source: Say the secret Password.
zh: 说出秘密口令。

source: Nothing to do let's give her money back if you have an idea you can tell her.
zh: 没办法，把钱还给她吧。想到什么主意，也可以告诉她。

source: Ah, traveler, heed my words. When you reach the place where you first set foot upon this island, seek the crimson tent. There, a radiant smile shall greet you, promising wonders untold.
zh: 啊，旅人，听我说。回到你第一次踏上这座岛的地方，寻找绯红的帐篷。那里会有灿烂的笑容迎接你，许诺无尽奇景。

zh: 啊，求问命运之人，仔细听好。想安抚那吝啬的猫女，就送上一份能让她心情变好的礼物。

source: Listen well, for an expert fisherman shall lend his aid. With his guidance, you will offer a gift to soothe the ire of a most ill-tempered cat.
zh: 仔细听，一位经验丰富的渔夫会助你一臂之力。在他的指引下，送上一份礼物，平息那只暴躁猫儿的怒火。

source: The cat's mind lingers on the gift, her thoughts entwined with your return. She waits, unaware of your intent to steal a kiss from her unsuspecting lips.
zh: 猫娘还惦记着那份礼物，思绪缠绕着你的归来。她静静等着，却不知道，你想从她毫无防备的唇上偷走一吻。

source: In the place where people lose consciousness, you shall overhear a conversation meant for other ears. Listen closely, for within it lies the information you seek.
zh: 在人们失去意识之地，你将听见一场本不该让你听到的谈话。仔细倾听，你要的消息，就藏在其中。

source: A familiar figure awaits payment, standing by the water at dawn. They linger before the place where you crafted your humble abode.
zh: 熟悉的身影在黎明的水边，等着收钱。就在你为自己安置陋居的地方前方。

zh: 忠实的宠物陪伴着美丽的植物，她在烈日下劳作一天，盼望你的帮助。

source: You will witness a dragon descending from the sky, where the cows graze peacefully.
zh: 你将见到巨龙从天而降，落在牛儿安静吃草的地方。

source: In the dusk, a restless woman will befriend your other half within the house of laughter.
zh: 暮色降临，欢笑之屋里，一位不安分的女人，会与你的另一半结为朋友。

source: Cows will witness you crossing paths with a person you only ever hoped to find in your dreams.
zh: 在牛儿的注视下，你将邂逅那个你曾以为只能在梦中遇见的人。

source: A bridge where lies await you leads to an individual of ambiguous values.
zh: 一座充满谎言的桥，通向一个是非观念暧昧不清的人。

source: In a place where people are mere objects, you will encounter someone as white as snow, but missing ashes.
zh: 在人被当成物件的地方，你会遇见一位白如雪、却缺少灰烬之人。

source: In the dead of night, within the silence of the forest, only a skilled magician remains.
zh: 夜深时，寂静的森林中，只留下一位娴熟的魔法师。

zh: 嗯……好，去西南边的酒店，告诉前台“霍妮女士有新员工”，她会告诉你下一步怎么做。

zh: 这场演出似乎很成功，观众笑得快断气了。

zh: 可、可是一直都是你做的呀！莉莉，你是我的使魔，这本来就是你的职责。

zh: 是啊，找她提升你的魅魔之力，也许真不太合适。

zh: 接受自己半魅魔的身份吧，拜托，你都二十岁了。

zh: 战斗中得用上魅魔能力，才能增加获胜机会。

Oh, it was nothing... Hey, this cellar doesn't look so bad
we could use it as a home while we're on the island.

哦，小事而已……嘿，这地下室看着也不赖。
我们待在岛上的时候，可以把它当家。

zh: 欢迎来到卡莉耶尔镇，这里是蜜月、探索性欲，以及包容所有人的首选之地。

source: The idea is to give her to drink alcohol so that she is drunk enough to give us some good discounts.

Do you know that it is also inappropriate? having sex behind my store.

zh: 说了那么多蹩脚情话，没想到最后竟然给我买了这么多酒。

zh: 别担心，我的宠物会吓跑所有来这里的人。

source: I-I am somewhat shy, I do not know if I can do it here, someone could see us.
zh: 我、我有点害羞，不知道能不能在这里，可能会被人看到。

source: God, you're slow, why are you taking so long?
zh: 天啊，你真慢，怎么花这么久？

source: Well whatever, it was the first time i had such aggressive sex <3

zh: 哦，等等，莉莉，能去酒店帮我拿钱包吗？001号房。

source: That sounds good, let's get in.

source: If you want to rest before leaving, we can enter.
zh: 走之前想休息的话，我们可以进去。

zh: 不算，我偶尔在里面睡觉。

source: Hey Line, This place is empty?
zh: 嘿，莱茵，这地方没人住？

source: Great go to the second floor of the hotel I'll wait for you there. <3
zh: 太好了，去旅馆二楼吧，我在那里等你<3。

source: It would be an honor lucy. <3

zh: 就靠你们了。圣物被盗，搞得我们人手紧张，尽量搭把手，别惹麻烦就行。

source: Oh, ok I will do it.(I just hope Ava is on the island)
zh: 哦，好，我会的。（只希望艾娃就在岛上。）

source: And if you see any person on the island with a problem that you can solve, you will also offer your help.
zh: 还有，在岛上看见有人遇到你能解决的困难，也要主动帮忙。

source: I will escort you to your boat.
zh: 我会护送你到船边。

source: If you stay you will hinder the search that is why the island is closed.
zh: 你留下，会妨碍搜查，所以才要封岛。

source: A relic was recently stolen from the island and the witness was able to identify that the perpetrator had horns.
zh: 最近，岛上的一件圣遗物被偷了。目击者辨认出，作案者长着角。

source: Wh-what why?
zh: 什、什么，为什么？

source: I am sorry but I will have to ask you to leave the island.
zh: 抱歉，不过得请你们离开这座岛。

source: Oh I ju-just arrived on a raft.
zh: 哦，我刚、刚坐木筏到这里。

source: I have never seen you on this island before.
zh: 以前从没在岛上见过你。

source: Ho-hello is there a problem?
zh: 你、你好，出什么事了吗？

source: Hey you unihorn, come here now!
zh: 喂，那个独角的，立刻过来！

source: And-we could pick up where we left off <3.
zh: 而且……我们还可以接着上次没做完的<3。

source: Great it will be the four of us, as soon as you get to the house, I'll make something you'll love!
zh: 太好了，我们四个一起。等你到了家，我就做些你绝对喜欢的东西！

source: I-I would love to Callie.
zh: 卡莉，我、我很愿意。

source: ( I-I do not want to give her false hope, I really do not want to hurt her but to reject her would also be rude. )
zh: （我、我不想给她虚假的希望，更不想伤害她，可拒绝也很失礼。）

source: Hey Line, I was wondering if you wanted to have lunch with me and my son at my house today?
zh: 嘿，莱茵，今天要不要来我家，跟我和儿子一起吃午饭？

source: That's okay, at least I'll keep my oldest son, he'll keep his old mother company.
zh: 没关系，至少大儿子还会留下，陪陪我这个老妈。

source: Oh... Callie I am so sorry.

zh: 算是吧，刚好出门，就看见孩子们跟爸爸走了。

source: I am so glad Callie, now you can be with your children.
zh: 真替你高兴，卡莉，终于能跟孩子们团聚了。

source: Yeah haha, it's not like I did anything serious enough to stay there any longer.
zh: 是啊，哈哈，我又没干什么严重到需要再关久点的事。

zh: 各位，快进来，最棒的商店欢迎所有人！

source: Ah why, what did I say?
zh: 啊？为什么，我说什么了？

source: ... I think you mean Come With you.
zh: ……我想，你想说的是跟你一起去。

source: Leafy Cum on my if you want to live! * extends her hand *
zh: 叶叶，想活命，就射到我身上！*伸出手*

source: Stop right there! you are under arrest by the law of Elira.
zh: 站住！依照艾莉拉法律，你被捕了。

source: She is attacking the saleswoman!
zh: 她在袭击售货员！

source: That is why we will go as fast as possible.
zh: 所以，我们会尽快赶过去。

source: How dangerous that it is so close where there are such vulnerable people.
zh: 这么危险的东西，居然离那些脆弱的人这么近。

zh: 去最后一个地点，就在医院前面。

source: But that will have to wait

zh: 嗯……只要弄清这些钥匙能打开什么，就能知道，到底发生了什么。

source: I knew it, here is another key!

zh: 好，已经喝够胆了，去向卡莉告白。

source: ... no drink ... no courage.

source: Miss that room is for employees only.

source: I know i'm awesome.

source: Great idea Lili <3.

source: OHh, Hi, mmm  I Have to go now, ehh sorry.

source: 300 Arcs.
... Shit, and how much does it cost?

zh: 莱茵……很抱歉，你被捕了。

zh: 哎呀，莉莉，别疑神疑鬼，我们可是英雄。也许叫我们来，是为了抓另一个罪犯。

source: Line!

source: shut up.

source: Hey now you have your mother's long tongue when you are completely aroused.

source: Moo moo ranch

source: Welcome to the Moo moo ranch prison and producer of the best breast milk of all dimensions. we also hire women and sell the best aphrodisiac fruits to fulfill any sexual desire <3.
zh: 欢迎来到哞哞牧场监狱，这里出产所有次元最棒的母乳。我们也招募女性，贩卖最好的催情水果，满足各种性欲<3。

source: She did not stay with me :c hopefully I can see her again hehe.
zh: 她没有跟我留下来:c，希望还能再见到她，嘿嘿。

source: In the meantime you can enjoy the activities the island has to offer.
zh: 这期间，可以体验一下岛上的各种活动。

source: Oh, I didn't know :c.

source: I do Sam :D, it is east of town, passing the bridge of lovers.

source: Ok going back to the topic, I was informed that the criminal would be in the magenta swamp, do you know where it is?
zh: 好，说回正事。情报说罪犯在洋红沼泽，你们知道她在哪儿吗？

source: Hey leave her alone!

source: Help the dragon maybe she gives us a reward.
zh: 帮帮那个龙女，说不定会给谢礼。

source: Lili what do we do?

source: For now we block the exit until the guards arrive.
zh: 先把出口堵住，等守卫过来。

source: We are prisoners if we get into someone else's fight they will increase our sentence.
zh: 我们是囚犯，掺和别人的打架，刑期会加长。

source: That dragon woman fell from the sky and the lamia seems to have stole something from her.

source: Hey! what's happening here?

source: Vasuki The Silver Dragon of Luminous
zh: 瓦苏基，卢米纳斯的银龙

source: Thank you very much you are very kind <3.

source: We know where it is, we will help you to return home.
zh: 我们知道在哪儿，会帮你回家的。

source: This one came with me, the other one from what I could see ended up in a place with many bright blue rocks.
zh: 这一块跟我一起过来了，另一块，看样子掉到了一个有好多发光蓝石头的地方。

source: Oh don't worry, the truth is I would like to go back but this crystal is only half the fracture.
zh: 哦，别担心。其实，我也想回去，可这块水晶，只是裂隙的一半。

source: Lili! Excuse her, she was born without touch.
zh: 莉莉！抱歉，她天生不懂分寸。

source: Wow.. it's a lot to digest but at least you already have the crystal to return to that horrible place.
zh: 哇……信息量真大，不过至少有水晶，能回那个可怕的地方了。

source: Yes, my dimension is called Luminous, right now a corrupt god is wreaking havoc and that is why my dimension has these dimensional fractures.
zh: 对，我的次元叫流明界。现在，一个堕落的神明正在那里肆虐，所以，我们次元才会出现这些裂隙。

source: Wait do you come from another dimension?
zh: 等等，你从另一个次元来的？

source: That crystal is really a dimensional rift and my only way to get back home.
zh: 那块水晶，实际上是次元裂隙，也是我回家的唯一途径。

source: That crystal, why is it so important to you?

source: Relax, it was nothing.

source: Yes, Thanks for helping me, I didn't have any more energy to fight.

source: Are you ok?

zh: 看，在开始偷之前就被发现，只会收到警告，而农场主就能光着身子干活了。

source: ....Whhaat?

source: Exactly..

source: You are insane! I do not want to go to jail.
zh: 你疯了！我可不想坐牢。

source: Look, if the farmer wants to be more comfortable at work, why don't you try to steal this milk?
zh: 听着，既然农场女工想工作得舒服点，为什么不试试，偷这桶牛奶？

source: What is it?
zh: 什么事？

source: Hey Line I think I have an idea.

source: Hey you people, what are you doing!

source: Ohh.... fine..

source: get naked, if that doesn't get you noticed, nothing will.

source: Mmm this woman does not realize what is going on around her, no wonder the inmates are escaping.

zh: 只警告一次，再偷东西，我发誓把你送到卫兵那里。

source: Have a nice day Miss the prison-farm is a good place to buy aphrodisiacs as well as exemplifying the sentences of people who break the law.
zh: 祝你今天愉快，小姐。监狱农场是买催情药的好地方，也能让大家看看，违法的人会受到什么惩罚。

source: You found one of the stolen relics! I'll give the news to the captain, you can go and return it to the church and I know they will be grateful.
zh: 你找到了被盗的圣遗物！我去向队长报告，你可以送回教堂，他们一定会很感激。

source: Oh it's out of order, I really want to go to the bathroom :c.
zh: 哦，坏了，我真的好想上厕所:c。

source: Well, it is out of order anyway.
zh: 反正也坏了，不能用。

source: I cannot get in here, it is the men's room.

source: Hey watchout!

source: No, over my dead body you ruin my whole plan!
zh: 不行，想毁掉我的整个计划，除非从我尸体上踩过去！

source: Ehhh... Agh it's ok what should I do.
zh: 呃……唉，好吧，该怎么做？

source: Not anymore, Line owes me.
zh: 现在可不是了，莱茵欠我的。

source: WHAT? But I'm the one who has to do it.
zh: 什么？可这事明明该我做。

source: Line? I need your help damn it, go to my place now!
zh: 莱茵？我需要你帮忙，妈的，立刻来我那里！

source: Oh that's a bit aggressive.
zh: 哦，这有点凶啊。

source: That's what worries me, you bloody gambler, if I see that you've turned the place into a casino I swear I'll kill you!
zh: 就是这点让人担心，你这个死赌鬼，要是敢把这里变成赌场，发誓我非杀了你！

source: Don't worry SieKi I will run the place even better than you.
zh: 别担心，茜姬，我会把这里管得比你还好。

source: Shit, I really don't want to but I didn't have time to look for someone.
zh: 妈的，真不想这么做，可没时间再找别人了。

source: Then she will take your place for a while, Sieki?

source: Stay out of my business!

source: and let me make it clear you are working so be professional and don't touch anything on my desk!

source: Oh I am sorry I am sorry I am running right now.
zh: 哦，对不起，对不起，马上就跑。

source: Line what are you waiting for stop talking and go to work!
zh: 莱茵，还等什么，别聊了，去干活！

source: Of course, there is no problem <3.

source: Thank you for opening your mind to me. It's been a long time since people came to see me. I'll give you advice as a gift. I see an evil being behind you, exposing your weakness. A shell of a being. If you don't find your ego, it will take its place, and you'll lose the little bit of individuality you have now.
zh: 谢谢你向我敞开心灵，很久没人来看我了。赠你一个忠告：你身后有个邪恶的存在，正暴露你的弱点，一个空壳般的存在。如果找不到真正的自我，它就会取而代之，你连现在这点独立人格都会失去。

source: Ah, I-I'm sorry, Line. No, no, I can't. My head, ah, it hurts. I don't know what's happening.
zh: 啊，对、对不起，莱茵。不，不，我不行。我的头，啊，好疼。我不知道，发生了什么。

source: Sh-shut up! I do not understand anything, Lili. Attack the serpent, please! I need you, please, make it stop!
zh: 闭、闭嘴！我什么都不懂，莉莉。攻击那条蛇，求你了！我需要你，求求你，让它停下！

source: You're a shallow, flat shell of a person. It's hard to even call you an individual. Your super ego in society makes people idolize you like a hero, a role model. But when you're alone, your id surfaces, revealing nothing more than an animal devoid of any reasoning.
zh: 你只是个肤浅、空洞的空壳，甚至很难称为独立的人。在社会中，你的超我让大家把你当成英雄、榜样，盲目崇拜。可独处时，本我浮出水面，剩下的，不过是一头毫无理性的野兽。

source: P-p-please, do not m-make me think about my family anymore. I-I beg you, get out of my head.
zh: 求、求、求你，别、别再让我想起家人了。求、求求你，从我脑子里滚出去。

source: Please, get out of my head. I do not want to hear anymore.
zh: 求你，从我脑子里出去，不想再听了。

source: You're right. You're a slut, and you're a saint. Your life has been about living between two extremes.
zh: 你说得对。你是个婊子，也是个圣人。你这一生，一直都活在两个极端之间。

source: Line, calm down. Ahh, my head, what's happening?
zh: 莱茵，冷静。啊，头好痛，怎么回事？

source: IT'S A LIE! I-I-I was always a good daughter in the village, a model daughter! I never did anything to shame my father!
zh: 骗人！我、我、我在村里一直是好女儿，模范女儿！从没做过让爸爸蒙羞的事！

source: Do you really want them to know what you are? A shameless woman whose only motive is carnal relief. Your father is better off without knowing you; your mother saved him from seeing his daughter fall into a hopeless pit.
zh: 你真想让他们知道，你是什么样的人？一个不知羞耻，满脑子只有肉欲发泄的女人。你父亲不知道你这样，反而更好；你母亲，替他挡住了亲眼看着女儿坠入绝望深渊的痛苦。

source: Wh-what! No, she w-wanted to h-help me get to kn-know myself, to t-truly experience and s-shape myself through int-interacting with other people!
zh: 什、什么！不，她、她想帮、帮我认识自己，通、通过和其他人来往，真正体、体验生活，塑、塑造自己！

source: Your mother helped you leave the village just so you wouldn't cause problems for your father.
zh: 你妈妈帮你离开村子，只是不想让你给父亲惹麻烦。

source: Line, are you okay?!
zh: 莱茵，你没事吧？！

source: Ah!? Why do I hear you in my head?
zh: 啊！？为什么脑子里有你的声音？

source: But you're just a nymphomaniac without morals, the nightmare of your father and the mistake of your mother.
zh: 你不过是个毫无道德的色情狂，你父亲的噩梦、你母亲犯下的错误。

source: *Starts to cry* Sniff, sniff, th-thank you, really. I thought I was a j-joke, just a nymphomaniac in the form of an elf who can not even be a w-woman of values like my f-father wanted.
zh: *哭起来*呜，呜，谢、谢谢你，真的。我还以为，自己就是个笑、笑话，不过是披着精灵外表的色情狂，连父、父亲希望的那种有、有品行的女人，都做不到。

source:
You're in a place where everyone gets what they want
your powers can't have an effect when everyone is already at the highest level of ecstasy.
zh:
这里人人都得偿所愿。
既然所有人都已经沉浸在最极致的狂喜之中，你的力量自然起不了作用。

source: B-ut I am succubus, they should be the ones desiring me more!
zh: 可、可我是魅魔，他们不该更想要我吗！

source: The most accurate thing is that your friend was a warrior dragon, something not commonly seen in those places. You shouldn't worry; they just desired her more.
zh: 更准确地说，你朋友是个龙族战士，在那种地方很少见。不必介意，他们只是更想要她。

source: Being half succubus doesn't necessarily mean you have to be the best in the sex. It could be due to various factors that VIPs liked your friend more than you.
zh: 半魅魔，不代表一定得最擅长做爱。贵宾们比起你，更喜欢你的朋友，可能有很多原因。

source: Th-the thing is, it seemed like people enjoyed being with her more than with me, and, well, being half succubus makes me feel like I am a disgrace, as if it were a mistake or something like that.
zh: 就、就是，好像大家跟她在一起，都比跟我更开心。而且，半魅魔这个身份，让我觉得，自己像个耻辱，像是什么错误。

source: Oh? Emm I think I have a question... *looks around* Not long ago, a friend and I were working in a VIP area on the island as onaholes.
zh: 哦？呃，有个问题……*环顾四周*不久前，我和朋友在岛上的一个VIP区，当过人形飞机杯。

source: Hello, I'm Veritus and I can answer any question!
zh: 你好，我叫维里图斯，什么问题都能回答！

source: It sticking out its little tongue, it is so adorable! <3
zh: 它在吐小舌头，太可爱了！<3

source: Look at the sea serpent, it is so cute! <3
zh: 看那条海蛇，好可爱<3！

source: Verity Pond

source: Warning! $%&/(%/ &$#%% in the Pond: Speaking to it is akin to facing a mirror of your innermost self. It can answer questions, but its cost is unknown and can negatively affect people. Caution and respect are advised, avoiding deceit. Enjoy the pond with care and consideration.
zh: 警告！池塘中的$%&/(%/ &$#%%：与它交谈，就如直视映照内心最深处的镜子。它能回答问题，却不知要付出何种代价，也可能对人造成不良影响。请谨慎、尊重，切勿欺骗。游览池塘时，请小心体谅。

source: Maybe I better leave.
zh: 我还是走吧。

source: Lili, did I wake up before you?
zh: 莉莉，我居然醒得比你早？

source: Ugh, what a horrible nightmare has happened?
zh: 呃，好可怕的噩梦，发生什么了？

source: Lovers bridge
zh: 恋人桥

source: Hey you cannot pass without paying the toll.
zh: 喂，没交过路费，不能过去。

source: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
zh: 喂！你想干什么？

source: It's the only thing you deserve for having the nerve to believe you can catch me.
zh: 敢以为自己能抓住我，这就是你唯一配得上的下场。

source: Here you have my stinking foot
zh: 给，我的臭脚。

source: Like the closet thirsty succubus that you are.
zh: 就像你这只装正经、却饥渴得要命的魅魔。

source: You will have to touch yourself here in front of passersby.
zh: 你得在这里，当着来来往往的人自慰。

source: Hehe I know a way that you can save your little friend.
zh: 嘿嘿，我知道一个办法，能救你的小朋友。

source: Please do not take Lili.
zh: 求你了，别带走莉莉。

source: I'll keep your fairy, it will sell very well on the black market.
zh: 这只仙子我留下了，黑市上能卖个好价钱。

source: I told you that your attempt to catch me was useless.
zh: 早告诉你了，想抓我，白费力气。

source: Well it does not matter I will go to your base.
zh: 好吧，没关系，我去你们基地。

source: But it seems you wanted it to come to this.
zh: 不过看来，是你非要走到这一步。

source: Hahaha you disgust me if you told me that before you would have saved yourself the humiliation.
zh: 哈哈哈，真恶心。早这么说，也不用丢这么大脸了。

source: Yes! and I'll take out the wanted posters.
zh: 好！我也会撤下通缉令。

source: Ple-please do not take Lili, we have a base you can hide.
zh: 求、求你，别带走莉莉，我们有个据点，能让你藏身。

source: Do not worry, we will give you 1000 Arcs as a reward, you just have to go and pick it up at the jail-farm.
zh: 别担心，赏金是1000阿克，去监狱农场领取就行。

source: Lili! do not be rude.
zh: 莉莉！别没礼貌。

source: And our reward?
zh: 那我们的奖励呢？

source: Oh.. there is nothing to be thankful for.
zh: 哦……没什么好谢的。

source: Thank you again, traveler, and this is the third criminal that we arrest thanks to you.
zh: 再次感谢，旅人，靠你们抓到的罪犯，这已经是第三个了。

source: But calm down if you lick the sweat you can pass your humiliation faster.
zh: 不过别急，舔掉这些汗，就能快点熬过这场羞辱。

source: The only way you can get rid of this is by reaching climax.
